$comment: Copy this to content/tools/specs/<slug>.json. The slug must be an approved backlog item. Then: npm run tool:new -- --spec content/tools/specs/<slug>.json
tagline: One line on what it tells them (10+ characters)
description: Sixty or more characters of plain English about what goes in and what comes out. No claims about results.
who: Who this is for, in plain English.
problem: The painful problem it points at, in the owner's words.
payoff: What they leave with. A number, a plan, or a document. Not a promise.
steps: Read the result and the assumptions under it.
formulaSource: Where the math comes from. Recorded in docs/TOOL_FORMULA_SOURCES.md before publication.

pro.$comment: Only for kind = pro. priceUsd must be one of PRO_PRICES.
pro.promise: One line on the outcome. Never a guarantee.
pro.freePreview: What a visitor can use before paying.
